targeting_gate.verbatim_anchor:
The purpose of this report is to describe areas that probably qualify as wetlands  from interpreta- 
tion of geographic information system (CIS) data layers, aerial photography, and field inspection   and to 
present some managerial guidelines for the use of these potential wetlands in the training areas on Ravenna 
AAP.
targeting_gate.rationale: Delineates probable existing wetlands to avoid military-training damage; incidental vehicle-created wetlands are not restoration implementation planning. Retain wetland-banking and hydrology referral rather than generic NbS establishment rule.
